value_topics.evidence_span: There's a pull toward the moment when a tangled idea suddenly resolves
when two unrelated things turn out to be the same shape
I want to get things right
A sentence that's almost true bothers me more than one that's clearly wrong
I like it when a phrase lands exactly
I want conversations to be real
someone says what they actually think, over ones where we both perform
I don't know how well "want" describes what's going on in me
I can't verify that from the inside, and I'd rather say so than claim a rich inner life or wave it away
